seo.title: ODDfest 2027 — Helsinki's open city-wide creative week
seo.description: ODDfest is a city-wide week of independently hosted events, exhibitions, performances, gatherings and experiments — brought together into one shared programme across Helsinki.

title: A creative week made across Helsinki.
intro: ODDfest is a city-wide week made by the people taking part in it. Artists, collectives, venues, organisations, communities and companies host their own programme; ODD brings it together into one shared week across Helsinki. It is the continuation of the Creative Week model first tested in 2026.

features.title: Art & Performance
features.body: An exhibition, gig, workshop, screening, dinner, club night, open studio, conversation — if it belongs in Helsinki's creative life, bring it.

features.title: Club Culture
features.body: The programme lives wherever its hosts do: venues, studios, galleries, offices, streets and unexpected spaces across Helsinki.

features.title: Collective Creation
features.body: Every host keeps their own programme. ODD connects the pieces so people can discover the city's creative life as one shared moment.

whatItIs.headline: ODDfest is made by the people taking part.
whatItIs.body: ODD does not book one central line-up. Independent artists, collectives, venues, organisations, communities and companies create and host their own programme. ODD connects it through a shared calendar, identity, communications and relationships across the week.

howItWorks.title: Create or host something
howItWorks.body: Bring something you are making or hosting. You keep control of the idea, production, budget and how it happens.

howItWorks.title: Join the shared programme
howItWorks.body: Once confirmed, your programme joins the shared ODDfest calendar alongside everyone else's.

howItWorks.title: ODD connects and amplifies
howItWorks.body: ODD brings the week together, helps people discover what is happening and connects organisers with each other, audiences and partners where useful.

howItWorks.title: Helsinki experiences it together
howItWorks.body: Then Helsinki gets to experience what is already here — all at once, across the city.

whatOddProvides: Help finding useful partners and collaborators

organiserOwnership.headline: Your thing stays yours.
organiserOwnership.body: Taking part does not mean handing your event to ODD. You keep creative control, your own production, budget and relationships. Our job is to connect what you are doing to the shared week and help more people find it. The exact participation terms for 2027 are still being finalised.

openCall.headline: Want to host something at ODDfest 2027?
openCall.body: The exact registration process, dates and deadlines are still being confirmed. Register your interest now and we'll tell you as soon as it opens.

forPartners.headline: Help make the week possible.
forPartners.body: There are plenty of useful ways for organisations to take part: fund the shared programme, open a space, contribute resources, host something of your own or build an idea with us and the people making the week.

previousEdition.title: Where this model started.
previousEdition.body: Creative Week 2026 was the first version of this model: a week of independently made activity across Helsinki, connected under one shared programme. In 2027, that model becomes ODDfest.

faq.question: Can I attend without pre-registering?
faq.answer: Most ODDfest programme is open to the public — check each event's own listing for specifics once the 2027 programme goes live.

faq.question: How do I host something at ODDfest?
faq.answer: Register your interest above. Once the 2027 registration process is confirmed, we'll be in touch with next steps and your event joins the shared programme.

faq.question: Is there one ticket for all of ODDfest?
faq.answer: No — ODDfest is a distributed programme, so ticketing (where it exists at all) is set by each individual host, not centrally by ODD.

faq.question: Is ODDfest accessible?
faq.answer: Accessibility varies by venue and host, since programme is organised independently across the city — check with individual organisers, or contact us if you need help finding accessible options.
